subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Which privacy-bounded memory/metrics surfaces should OpenClaw expose for cross-session recall, agent-facing metrics, and restart preload, and should this umbrella be split before implementation?
rationale: The remaining work changes what session, memory, provider, cost, and auth-profile data can be surfaced to agents, skills, UI, CLI, or startup flows, so source inspection cannot safely choose defaults without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella, create narrower design/implementation items for metrics, recall scope, session handoff, and restart preload, and require privacy/security acceptance criteria before code.

options.title: Sponsor one integrated RFC
options.body: Assign an owner to produce a single product/security RFC that resolves all four requested surfaces before implementation PRs.

options.title: Narrow to existing surfaces
options.body: Close or supersede pieces already handled by existing memorySearch/sessionMemory/usage/startupContext paths and keep only the missing API gaps as separate issues.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the umbrella, create narrower design/implementation items for metrics, recall scope, session handoff, and restart preload, and require privacy/security acceptance criteria before code.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combination of feature-history signal and prior product-review context on this exact issue.
